title.zh: 卷388 列傳一百七十五 桂良 瑞麟子：怀塔布 官文 文煜
title.en: Volume 388 Biographies 175: Gui Liang, Rui Lin son: Huai Tabu, Guan Wen, Wen Yu
title.raw: 卷388 列傳一百七十五 桂良 瑞麟子：怀塔布 官文 文煜

sentences.zh: 桂良，字燕山，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正紅旗人，閩浙總督玉德子。

translations.literal: Gui Liang, style name Yanshan, of the Guwalgiya clan, a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner, was the son of Yude, governor-general of Fujian-Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang, whose style was Yanshan, belonged to the Guwalgiya clan. A Manchu of the Plain Red Banner, he was the son of Yude, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 入貲為禮部主事，晉員外郎。

translations.literal: He purchased office and entered the Ministry of Rites as a principal clerk, then was promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: He bought his way into office as a principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites and was later promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 出為四川順慶知府，調成都。

translations.literal: He went out as prefect of Shunqing in Sichuan, then was transferred to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: He served abroad as prefect of Shunqing in Sichuan and was then transferred to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 歷建昌道，河南按察使，四川、廣東、江西布政使。

translations.literal: He successively served as circuit intendant of Jianchang, surveillance commissioner of Henan, and provincial administration commissioner of Sichuan, Guangdong, and Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He held successive posts as Jianchang circuit intendant, Henan surveillance commissioner, and administration commissioner of Sichuan, Guangdong, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 道光十四年，擢河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Daoguang he was promoted to governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Daoguang reign (1834), he was promoted to governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，林清、李文成等以八卦教倡亂，既誅，而汲縣潞州屯墳塔猶祀其神曰「無生老母」，習教者猶眾。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing era Lin Qing, Li Wencheng, and others had raised rebellion through the Eight Trigrams teaching; after they were executed, at the Luanzhou village mound and pagoda in Jixian people still worshipped their deity as the 'Eternal Mother Without Birth,' and those who practiced the teaching remained numerous.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiaqing era Lin Qing, Li Wencheng, and others had stirred rebellion in the name of the Eight Trigrams sect. After they were put to death, the village mound and pagoda at Luanzhou in Jixian still enshrined their god as the 'Eternal Mother Without Birth,' and adherents of the teaching remained many.

sentences.zh: 御史黃爵滋以為言，命桂良察治，毀其墳廟，廉得河南境內無生廟三十九所，並毀之；

translations.literal: Censor Huang Juesi reported this; the court ordered Gui Liang to investigate and punish it. He destroyed the tombs and shrines, and on investigation found thirty-nine Wusheng shrines within Henan, all of which he demolished as well;
translations.idiomatic: When Censor Huang Juesi brought the matter forward, the court ordered Gui Liang to investigate. He destroyed the tombs and temples, and on inquiry found thirty-nine 'Wusheng' shrines within Henan and demolished them all as well;

sentences.zh: 地方官失察，譴黜有差。

translations.literal: Local officials who had failed in oversight were censured and dismissed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials who had failed to detect the sect were rebuked and dismissed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十九年，擢湖廣總督，調閩浙，又調雲貴。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was promoted governor-general of Huguang, transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang, then again to Yunnan-Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he was made governor-general of Huguang, transferred to Fujian and Zhejiang, and then to Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年，兼署雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he concurrently acted as governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he also served as acting governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 滇省多盜，奏定緝捕章程；

translations.literal: Yunnan had many bandits; he memorialized fixing regulations for pursuit and arrest;
translations.idiomatic: Banditry was rife in Yunnan; he memorialized establishing regulations for pursuit and capture;

sentences.zh: 又請迤南、迤西、迤東各標營官兵責成巡道就近稽察。

translations.literal: He also requested that troops of each garrison banner in southern, western, and eastern Yunnan be charged to the circuit intendants for nearby inspection.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that garrison troops in southern, western, and eastern Yunnan be placed under nearby circuit intendants for inspection.

sentences.zh: 時貴州諸苗蠢動，鎮遠、黎平、都勻、古州苗尤悍，州縣不能制，疏請遴勁兵專主剿捕。

translations.literal: At that time various Miao in Guizhou were stirring; those of Zhenyuan, Liping, Duyun, and Guzhou were especially fierce and prefectures and counties could not control them. He memorialized requesting selection of crack troops devoted solely to suppression.
translations.idiomatic: At that time various Miao groups in Guizhou were in unrest; those around Zhenyuan, Liping, Duyun, and Guzhou were especially fierce, and local prefectures and counties could not contain them. He memorialized asking that crack troops be chosen to devote themselves solely to suppression.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，入覲，留京，署兵部尚書，兼正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he came to court for audience, remained in the capital, and acted as minister of War while concurrently serving as lieutenant general of the Plain White Banner Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he came to court for audience, stayed in the capital, acted as minister of War, and concurrently served as lieutenant general of the Plain White Banner Han Army.

sentences.zh: 尋出為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Soon after he went out as commander at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed commander at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，召來京，以其女妻皇六子奕訢，授鑲紅旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was summoned to the capital; his daughter was given in marriage to the emperor's sixth son Yixin, and he was appointed lieutenant general of the Bordered Red Banner Han Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was recalled to the capital. His daughter was married to the emperor's sixth son, Prince Yixin, and he was appointed lieutenant general of the Bordered Red Banner Han Army.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，署吏部尚書，出為福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he acted as minister of Personnel and went out as general at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng (1851) he acted as minister of Personnel, then went out as general at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，召授兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year he was summoned and appointed minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was recalled and appointed minister of War.

sentences.zh: 三年，粵匪陷江寧，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the third year the Guangdong rebels took Jiangning and the capital went on alert.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Guangdong rebels captured Jiangning, and the capital was placed under martial alert.

sentences.zh: 桂良疏請各城門稽查增派八旗章京兵丁，補葺城上兵房，從之。

translations.literal: Gui Liang memorialized asking that inspections at each city gate be strengthened with additional Manchu clerks and banner soldiers, and that troops' quarters atop the walls be repaired; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang memorialized that inspections at every city gate be tightened with additional banner clerks and soldiers, and that the guardhouses on the walls be repaired; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，粵匪竄河北，直隸總督訥爾經額出省防剿，命桂良駐保定為後路聲援，兼防西路要隘。

translations.literal: Before long the Guangdong rebels raided into Hebei. Governor-General Ne'erjing'e went out of the province to defend and suppress them; Gui Liang was ordered to garrison at Baoding to support the rear and also guard key passes on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the rebels from Guangdong raided into Hebei. Governor-General Ne'erjing'e left the province to defend and suppress them, while Gui Liang was ordered to hold Baoding as a rear support and guard key passes on the western route.

sentences.zh: 望都、唐縣土匪起，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose at Wangdu and Tang counties; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Wangdu and Tang counties; they were captured and put to death.

sentences.zh: 是年秋，賊由山西犯畿南，訥爾經額師潰於臨洺關，隆平、柏鄉相繼陷。

translations.literal: That autumn the rebels invaded the southern capital region from Shanxi. Ne'erjing'e's army was routed at Linming Pass; Longping and Baixiang fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the rebels entered the southern capital region from Shanxi. Ne'erjing'e's army was routed at Linming Pass, and Longping and Baixiang fell one after another.

sentences.zh: 訥爾經額褫職逮治，授桂良直隸總督，詔責偕都統勝保速籌防剿。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e was stripped of office and arrested for trial; Gui Liang was appointed governor-general of Zhili. An edict rebuked him and ordered that together with Commander Sengbao he speedily plan defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e was stripped of office and arrested. Gui Liang was appointed governor-general of Zhili, and an edict rebuked him and ordered that together with Commander Sengbao he quickly organize defense and suppression.

sentences.zh: 布政使張集馨出兵遷延，劾罷之。

translations.literal: Provincial administration commissioner Zhang Jixin led troops with delay; he was impeached and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial administration commissioner Zhang Jixin delayed in leading troops out; Gui Liang impeached him and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 賊竄正定、定州、深州、河間、天津，勢剽甚，於是桂良率提督張殿元守保定，科爾沁郡王僧格林沁統大兵駐通州衛京師，勝保督師進剿。

translations.literal: The rebels raided through Zhengding, Dingzhou, Shenzhou, Hejian, and Tianjin; their momentum was very fierce. Gui Liang then led provincial military commissioner Zhang Dianyuan to hold Baoding, while Prince Senggerinchen of Khorchin commanded the main army at Tongzhou to guard the capital; Sengbao directed the army in pursuit and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels swept through Zhengding, Dingzhou, Shenzhou, Hejian, and Tianjin with fierce momentum. Gui Liang then led provincial military commissioner Zhang Dianyuan to hold Baoding, while Prince Senggerinchen of Khorchin commanded the main force at Tongzhou to guard the capital and Sengbao directed the army in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 四年，大捷於獨流鎮，賊走踞阜城，又走連鎮，僧格林沁、勝保會攻，賊分竄山東，勝保追擊之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year a great victory was won at Duliuzhen; the rebels withdrew to hold Fucheng, then fled to Lianzhen. Senggerinchen and Sengbao attacked jointly; the rebels split and fled into Shandong, and Sengbao pursued them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year a great victory was won at Duliuzhen. The rebels withdrew to Fucheng, then fled to Lianzhen. Senggerinchen and Sengbao attacked together; the rebels split and fled into Shandong, and Sengbao pursued them.

sentences.zh: 桂良遣張殿元赴武邑防堵，劾散秩大臣穆輅、健銳營翼長雙僖縱兵傷官擾民，議譴。

translations.literal: Gui Liang sent Zhang Dianyuan to Wuyi to block them, and impeached the brevet grand secretary Mulu and First Company Commander Shuangxi for letting their soldiers wound officials and disturb the people; punishment was debated.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang sent Zhang Dianyuan to Wuyi to block the rebels and impeached brevet grand secretary Mulu and First Company Commander Shuangxi for allowing their troops to wound officials and harass the populace; their punishment was debated.

sentences.zh: 秋，英吉利、美利堅兩國兵船至大沽。

translations.literal: In autumn British and American warships arrived at Dagu.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn warships of Britain and the United States arrived at Dagu.

sentences.zh: 時賊氛未靖，詔戒張皇，命桂良相機辦理。

translations.literal: Rebel disturbances were not yet pacified; an edict warned against alarm and ordered Gui Liang to handle matters as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel unrest had not yet been pacified; an edict warned against panic and ordered Gui Liang to handle matters as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 尋以前任鹽政崇綸歸調遣，令赴天津會議。

translations.literal: Soon the former salt controller Chonglun was recalled for assignment and ordered to go to Tianjin for negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the former salt controller Chonglun was recalled to service and ordered to Tianjin for negotiations.

sentences.zh: 英酋咆呤要索十六條，欲遣官駐京及踐廣州入城之約，中外官平禮接見，通商稅則變通舊約；

translations.literal: The British chief Elgin demanded sixteen articles, wishing to send officials to reside in Beijing and to carry out the agreement on entering Guangzhou, to be received by Chinese and foreign officials on equal ceremonial terms, and to modify trade and tariff provisions of the old treaty;
translations.idiomatic: The British chief Elgin demanded sixteen articles: resident officials in Beijing, fulfillment of the agreement on entering Guangzhou, reception of Chinese and foreign officials on equal ceremonial footing, and revision of trade and tariff provisions under the old treaty;

sentences.zh: 美酋麥蓮則僅言通商一端。

translations.literal: The American chief McLane spoke only of trade.
translations.idiomatic: The American chief McLane raised only the question of trade.

sentences.zh: 崇綸等嚴拒其駐京，餘事令赴廣東聽總督查辦。

translations.literal: Chonglun and others sternly refused residence in Beijing; on the rest they were told to go to Guangzhou and await orders from the governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Chonglun and the others firmly refused residence in Beijing and told them to take all other matters to Guangzhou for the governor-general to handle.

sentences.zh: 屢議無要領，咆呤等尋去。

translations.literal: Repeated negotiations yielded no result, and Elgin and the others soon departed.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated talks without agreement, Elgin and his party soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年，僧格林沁連大破賊，賊首林鳳祥、李開芳先後就擒伏誅，畿輔肅清。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Senggerinchen won successive great victories over the rebels; the rebel leaders Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang were captured in turn and executed, and the capital region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Senggerinchen won a series of great victories. The rebel leaders Lin Fengxiang and Li Kaifang were captured in succession and executed, and the capital region was cleared.

sentences.zh: 七年，召拜東閣大學士，管理刑部，兼正藍旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was summoned and appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, put in charge of the Ministry of Punishments, and concurrently lieutenant general of the Plain Blue Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was summoned and appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments, and made concurrent lieutenant general of the Plain Blue Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 八年春，英、法、俄、美四國聯軍北犯，毀大沽砲台，泊天津城下，聲言將犯京師。

translations.literal: In spring of the eighth year the allied armies of Britain, France, Russia, and America invaded northward, destroyed the Dagu batteries, anchored below Tianjin, and declared they would attack the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year the allied forces of Britain, France, Russia, and the United States marched north, destroyed the Dagu batteries, anchored below Tianjin, and declared they would advance on the capital.

sentences.zh: 倉猝援軍未集，命桂良偕尚書花沙納往議。

translations.literal: Reinforcements could not be assembled in haste; Gui Liang was ordered to go with Minister Huashana to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements could not be gathered in time, and Gui Liang was ordered to go with Minister Huashana to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 敵情猖肆，要求益多：以遣官駐京、內江通商、內地遊行、兵費賠償後，始交還廣東省城。

translations.literal: The enemy was overbearing and their demands increased: only after dispatch of resident officials in Beijing, trade on inland rivers, travel inland, and payment of indemnity for military expenses would they return Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy grew more aggressive and their demands multiplied: only after resident officials in Beijing, trade on inland rivers, inland travel, and payment of military indemnity would they return the provincial city of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四事廷議不允。

translations.literal: On these four points the court deliberated and would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated on these four points and would not consent.

sentences.zh: 復起故大學士耆英同與議，英人尤不悅，拒之，耆英以擅回京獲罪。

translations.literal: The former Grand Secretary Qiying was again raised to join the talks; the British were especially displeased and refused him. Qiying was punished for returning to the capital without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: The former Grand Secretary Qiying was again brought in to negotiate, but the British were especially displeased and refused him. Qiying was punished for returning to the capital without authorization.

sentences.zh: 桂良等議久不決，廷臣多主戰，實不足恃，而敵日以進兵為恐哧。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and the others debated long without decision. Many court officials favored war, but in fact that could not be relied upon, while the enemy day by day used advancing troops as intimidation.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang and his colleagues debated for a long time without reaching a decision. Many court officials favored war, but that was not in fact a reliable option, while the enemy daily used the threat of advancing troops as intimidation.

sentences.zh: 俄、美兩國調停其間，卒徇所請定議，而通商稅則俟於上海詳定之。

translations.literal: Russia and America mediated between them; in the end [the Qing] yielded to their requests and fixed the agreement, while trade tariffs were to be settled in detail at Shanghai.
translations.idiomatic: Russia and the United States mediated between the parties; in the end the court yielded to their demands and concluded the agreement, while trade tariffs were to be worked out in detail at Shanghai.

sentences.zh: 五月，簽約退兵，遂命桂良偕花沙納赴上海，武備院卿明善、刑部員外郎段承實副之，會同兩江總督何桂清議稅則。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, after signing the treaty the troops withdrew; Gui Liang and Huashana were then ordered to go to Shanghai, with Court Superintendent Mingshan and vice director of punishments Duan Chengshi as deputies, jointly with Governor-General He Guiqing to negotiate tariffs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, after the treaty was signed the troops withdrew. Gui Liang and Huashana were then sent to Shanghai, with Court Superintendent Mingshan and vice director of punishments Duan Chengshi as deputies, to negotiate tariffs jointly with Governor-General He Guiqing.

sentences.zh: 文宗憤和約之成出於不得已，或獻策許全免入口稅以市惠，冀改易駐京諸條，密授桂良等機宜。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong resented that the treaty had been concluded only from necessity; some proposed granting complete exemption from import duties to win favor, hoping to alter the articles on residence in Beijing. He secretly gave Gui Liang and the others confidential instructions.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong resented that the treaty had been concluded only under duress. Some advisers proposed granting complete exemption from import duties to win goodwill, hoping thereby to alter the articles on residence in Beijing. He secretly gave Gui Liang and his colleagues confidential instructions.

sentences.zh: 八月，至上海，晉文華殿大學士，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month they reached Shanghai; Gui Liang was promoted Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and appointed imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month they reached Shanghai. Gui Liang was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Glory and appointed an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 桂清力言免稅之不可，改約之難成，桂良亦贊其議，上甚怒，必責其補救一二端，而各國因廣東民團仍與為難，且出示偽載諭旨，堅欲罷兩廣總督黃宗漢，停撤民團。

translations.literal: He Guiqing forcefully argued that exemption could not be granted and revision of the treaty could not succeed; Gui Liang also endorsed his view. The emperor was very angry and insisted they remedy at least one or two points. Meanwhile the various powers, because Guangdong militia still clashed with them and even produced forged imperial edicts, firmly demanded dismissal of Governor-General Huang Zonghan and halting withdrawal of the militia.
translations.idiomatic: He Guiqing argued forcefully that duty exemption was impossible and treaty revision could not succeed; Gui Liang supported him. The emperor was furious and insisted they salvage at least one or two points. Meanwhile the foreign powers, citing continued clashes with Guangdong militia and even producing forged imperial edicts, firmly demanded the dismissal of Governor-General Huang Zonghan and that the militia not be disbanded.

sentences.zh: 桂良等疏聞，乃解宗漢通商大臣，改授桂清。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and the others reported this by memorial; Huang Zonghan was then relieved of his post as trade commissioner and He Guiqing was appointed in his place.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang and his colleagues reported this by memorial, and Huang Zonghan was relieved of his post as trade commissioner and replaced by He Guiqing.

sentences.zh: 桂良等噤不敢言罷駐京諸事，先議稅則。

translations.literal: Gui Liang and the others dared not speak of abolishing residence in Beijing and related matters; they first negotiated tariffs.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Liang and the others dared not raise abolition of residence in Beijing and related matters, and turned first to negotiating tariffs.

sentences.zh: 十二月，英使額羅金遽率兵船赴廣東，遂罷議。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the British envoy Elgin abruptly led warships to Guangdong, and negotiations were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the British envoy Elgin suddenly led warships to Guangdong, and the talks were broken off.

sentences.zh: 九年，回京，僅美利堅一國遵換通商之約，英軍复犯大沽，僧格林沁預設備，兵至，擊退之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year they returned to the capital; only the United States followed the treaty on exchange of trade provisions. The British army again attacked Dagu; Senggerinchen had made preparations, and when the troops arrived they were repulsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year they returned to the capital. Only the United States carried out the treaty exchange on trade. The British army again attacked Dagu, but Senggerinchen had made preparations and repulsed them when they arrived.

sentences.zh: 十年，英法聯軍大舉來犯，我師失利。

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Anglo-French allied forces came in great strength; our troops suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Anglo-French allied armies invaded in force, and our forces were defeated.

sentences.zh: 七月，復命桂良赴天津議和，要增兵費，入京換約，嚴詔拒絕。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Gui Liang was again ordered to Tianjin to negotiate peace; they demanded increased military indemnity and exchange of the treaty in Beijing; stern edicts refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Gui Liang was again ordered to Tianjin to negotiate peace. The allies demanded increased military indemnity and exchange of the treaty in Beijing, but stern edicts refused.

sentences.zh: 敵陷天津，進逼京師，上幸熱河，恭親王奕訢留守主撫議，桂良與焉。

translations.literal: The enemy took Tianjin and pressed on the capital. The emperor went to Rehe; Prince Yixin remained to oversee pacification and negotiation, and Gui Liang took part.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy captured Tianjin and pressed toward the capital. The emperor went to Rehe, while Prince Yixin remained behind to oversee pacification and negotiation, with Gui Liang among those assisting.

sentences.zh: 九月，於禮部換約，視八年原議益增條款，事具邦交志。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the treaty was exchanged at the Ministry of Rites; compared with the original agreement of the eighth year the articles were further increased—details are in the section on foreign relations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the treaty was exchanged at the Ministry of Rites. Compared with the original agreement of the eighth year, the terms were further expanded; details are given in the section on foreign relations.

sentences.zh: 尋命督辦各國通商事務。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to supervise trade affairs with the various countries.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was ordered to supervise trade affairs with the various foreign powers.

sentences.zh: 十一年，穆宗即位，回京，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Emperor Muzong succeeded; [Gui Liang] returned to the capital and was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Emperor Muzong succeeded to the throne. Gui Liang returned to the capital and was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，卒，優恤，贈太傅，祀賢良祠，諡文端。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he died; favoring mourning rites were granted, posthumously appointed Grand Tutor, enshrined in the Temple of Worthy Officials, and given the posthumous name Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he died. The court granted him favored mourning honors, posthumously appointed him Grand Tutor, enshrined him in the Temple of Worthy Officials, and gave him the posthumous name Wenduan.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟，字澄泉，葉赫那喇氏，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Rui Lin, style name Chengquan, of the Yehe Nara clan, a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin, whose style was Chengquan, belonged to the Yehe Nara clan and was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 由文生充太常寺讀祝官，補贊禮郎。

translations.literal: As a civil licentiate he served as reader of invocations at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was appointed ritual officer.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a civil licentiate, he served as reader of invocations at the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and was appointed a ritual officer.

sentences.zh: 道光二十七年，祫祭太廟，讀祝洪亮，宣宗嘉之，賜五品頂戴、花翎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang, at the triennial sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, his reading of the invocation was sonorous; the Xuanzong Emperor commended this and granted him fifth-rank rank and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year of Daoguang, at the triennial joint sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, his reading of the invocation was resonant. The Xuanzong Emperor praised him and granted him fifth-rank insignia and a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，超擢太常寺少卿，又擢內閣學士，兼管太常寺。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was abruptly promoted vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then promoted Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat while concurrently managing the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was abruptly promoted to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, then to Grand Secretariat academician while concurrently managing that court.

sentences.zh: 三十年，擢禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was promoted vice minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to vice minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，兼鑲藍旗滿洲副都統、正黃旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he concurrently served as vice lieutenant general of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus and commander of the guards of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he concurrently served as vice lieutenant general of the Bordered Blue Banner Manchus and commander of the Plain Yellow Banner guards.

sentences.zh: 三年，調戶部，命在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: In the third year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was transferred to the Ministry of Revenue and ordered to serve on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 時粵匪竄畿輔，踞靜海縣及獨流鎮，命瑞麟率兵從僧格林沁防剿，會攻獨流，克之。

translations.literal: At that time Guangdong rebels had raided into the capital region and held Jinghai county and Duliuzhen; Rui Lin was ordered to lead troops with Senggerinchen for defense and suppression; they jointly attacked Duliuzhen and took it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Guangdong rebels had raided into the capital region and held Jinghai county and Duliuzhen. Rui Lin was ordered to lead troops with Senggerinchen in defense and suppression; they jointly attacked Duliuzhen and captured it.

sentences.zh: 靜海賊竄陷阜城，又分竄連鎮及山東高唐州，瑞麟合擊，屢有擒斬。

translations.literal: Rebels at Jinghai fled and took Fucheng, then split and raided Lianzhen and Gaotang in Shandong; Rui Lin combined forces and attacked, repeatedly capturing and killing.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinghai rebels fled and seized Fucheng, then split and raided Lianzhen and Gaotang in Shandong. Rui Lin combined forces and attacked, repeatedly capturing and killing the enemy.

sentences.zh: 五年，克連鎮，賊首林鳳祥就擒，加都統銜，賜號巴達瑯阿巴圖魯，授西安將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Lianzhen was taken; rebel leader Lin Fengxiang was captured; he was given commandant rank, the title Badarang A Batulu, and appointed general at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Lianzhen was taken and the rebel leader Lin Fengxiang was captured. Rui Lin was given commandant rank, granted the title Badarang A Batulu, and appointed general at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 未幾，擢禮部尚書，兼鑲白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted minister of Rites and concurrently lieutenant general of the Bordered White Banner Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to minister of Rites and made concurrent lieutenant general of the Bordered White Banner Mongols.

sentences.zh: 八年，英兵犯天津，命馳赴楊村籌防。

translations.literal: In the eighth year when British troops threatened Tianjin he was ordered to hasten to Yangcun to organize defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when British troops threatened Tianjin, he was ordered to hurry to Yangcun to organize defenses.

sentences.zh: 洎撫議定，敵退。

translations.literal: When pacification by negotiation was settled the enemy withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When peace was concluded by negotiation, the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 文宗知和不可恃，亟治海防，命瑞麟赴天津修築大沽砲台。

translations.literal: Emperor Wenzong knew peace could not be relied on and urgently strengthened coastal defenses; Rui Lin was ordered to go to Tianjin to rebuild the Dagu batteries.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong knew peace could not be relied upon and urgently strengthened coastal defenses. Rui Lin was ordered to Tianjin to rebuild the Dagu batteries.

sentences.zh: 尋署直隸總督，增建雙港砲台，調福建霆船戰船，增募水師。

translations.literal: Soon he acted as governor-general of Zhili, added construction of batteries at Shuanggang, transferred Fujian lightning war junks, and expanded the naval force.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served as acting governor-general of Zhili, built additional batteries at Shuanggang, transferred Fujian war junks, and expanded the naval force.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁移師天津，分駐要隘。

translations.literal: Senggerinchen moved his army to Tianjin and garrisoned key points in sections.
translations.idiomatic: Senggerinchen moved his army to Tianjin and stationed troops at key points in detachments.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟回京，調戶部尚書緦拜文淵閣大學士，兼管禮部鴻臚寺、太常寺。

translations.literal: Rui Lin returned to the capital, was transferred to minister of Revenue, and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Treasures, concurrently managing the Boards of Rites, Ceremonies, and Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin returned to the capital, was made minister of Revenue, and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, while also overseeing the Boards of Rites, Ceremonies, and Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 九年，管理戶部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he supervised the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he took charge of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十年，充殿試讀卷官，授內大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he served as reader at the palace examination and was appointed imperial bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he served as reader at the palace examination and was appointed an imperial bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 六月，英法聯軍复犯天津，命率京兵萬人守通州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Anglo-French allied forces again attacked Tianjin; he was ordered to lead ten thousand capital troops to guard Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Anglo-French allied armies again attacked Tianjin, and he was ordered to lead ten thousand capital troops to hold Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁屢戰失利，敵軍進通州，瑞麟偕勝保御之八里橋，左右夾擊，勝保傷砲墜馬，軍潰，敵遂逼京師。

translations.literal: Senggerinchen suffered repeated defeats; the enemy army advanced on Tongzhou. Rui Lin and Sengbao defended them at Baliqiao; attacking from left and right, Sengbao was wounded by gunfire and fell from his horse; the army was routed and the enemy then pressed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Senggerinchen suffered repeated defeats, and the enemy advanced on Tongzhou. Rui Lin and Sengbao met them at Baliqiao in a pincer attack, but Sengbao was wounded by gunfire and fell from his horse. The army was routed, and the enemy then pressed on the capital.

sentences.zh: 瑞麟迎戰安定門外，敗績，褫職。

translations.literal: Rui Lin met the enemy outside Anding Gate, was defeated, and was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Rui Lin met the enemy outside Anding Gate, was defeated, and was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸熱河，命扈從行在。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage went to Rehe he was ordered to accompany the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went to Rehe, Rui Lin was ordered to accompany the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，和議成，予侍郎銜，隨僧格林沁剿山東捻匪。

translations.literal: That winter when peace was concluded he was given vice minister rank and followed Senggerinchen to suppress the Nian rebels in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, when peace was concluded, he was given vice-minister rank and followed Senggerinchen to suppress the Nian rebels in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 攻鉅野羊山集賊巢，失利，馬蹶被傷，退軍濟寧，复褫職，召回京。

translations.literal: Attacking the rebel nest at Yangshanji in Juye, they suffered defeat; his horse stumbled and he was wounded; the army withdrew to Jining and he was again stripped of office and recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In an attack on the rebel nest at Yangshanji in Juye they were defeated. His horse stumbled and he was wounded; the army withdrew to Jining, he was again stripped of office, and was recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授鑲黃旗漢軍都統，管神機營事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed lieutenant general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Han Army and oversaw affairs of the Firearms Division.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed lieutenant general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Han Army and placed in charge of the Firearms Division.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，出為熱河都統，疏請招佃圍邊荒地八千頃充練餉，允之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he went out as commander at Rehe; he memorialized requesting tenant cultivation of eight thousand qing of waste land along the border hunt grounds to supply training funds; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he was appointed commander at Rehe. He memorialized asking that eight thousand qing of waste land along the imperial hunt borders be opened to tenant farmers to supply training funds, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二年，調廣州將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred general at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to general at Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，兼署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he concurrently acted as governor-general of Guangdong-Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he also served as acting governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 信宜、化州土匪起，遣兵平之。

translations.literal: Bandits rose at Xinyi and Huazhou; he sent troops and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Xinyi and Huazhou; he sent troops and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 粵匪汪海洋由福建竄廣東大埔，遣副將方耀擊走之。

translations.literal: The Guangdong rebel Wang Haiyang from Fujian raided into Dabu, Guangdong; he sent Deputy Commander Fang Yao to drive him off.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong rebel Wang Haiyang raided from Fujian into Dabu in Guangdong; Rui Lin sent Deputy Commander Fang Yao to drive him off.

sentences.zh: 入閩會剿，复詔安、平和。

translations.literal: He entered Fujian for joint suppression and recovered Zhang'an and Pinghe.
translations.idiomatic: He entered Fujian for joint suppression and recovered Zhang'an and Pinghe.

sentences.zh: 賊复竄廣東境，連敗之於長樂、鎮平。

translations.literal: The rebels again raided into Guangdong and were repeatedly defeated at Changle and Zhenping.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels again crossed into Guangdong and were repeatedly defeated at Changle and Zhenping.

sentences.zh: 時賊踪往來於福建、廣東、江西界上，瑞麟偕左宗棠疏請三省會剿。

translations.literal: As rebel tracks crossed the borders of Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangxi, Rui Lin and Zuo Zongtang jointly memorialized requesting three-province joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: As rebel movements crossed the borders of Fujian, Guangdong, and Jiangxi, Rui Lin and Zuo Zongtang jointly memorialized requesting a three-province joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 詔提督鮑超由江西來援，四面環攻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Regional Commander Bao Chao to come from Jiangxi in aid; they attacked from all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered regional commander Bao Chao to come from Jiangxi in support, and the forces attacked from all sides.

sentences.zh: 十二月，殲偽偕王譚體元於黃沙壩，擒首逆汪海洋，誅之，餘賊肅清。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the false adjoining king Tan Tiyuan was destroyed at Huangshaba, the chief rebel Wang Haiyang was captured and executed, and the remaining rebels were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the false prince Tan Tiyuan was destroyed at Huangshaba, the chief rebel Wang Haiyang was captured and executed, and the remaining rebels were cleared away.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，優詔嘉獎。

translations.literal: When victory was reported, an edict of special commendation was issued.
translations.idiomatic: When news of victory arrived, the court issued an edict of special commendation.

sentences.zh: 五年，實授兩廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was formally appointed governor-general of Guangdong-Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was formally appointed governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 廣東素多盜，伏莽時起。

translations.literal: Guangdong had always had many bandits; hidden malcontents erupted from time to time.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong had long been troubled by bandits, and hidden malcontents rose from time to time.

sentences.zh: 時巡撫蔣益澧號知兵，瑞麟部將方耀、鄭紹忠皆能戰，先後破斬五坑客匪，曹沖、赤溪及新安、東莞諸匪，潮州、瓊州洋盜、土匪。

translations.literal: The governor at the time, Jiang Yizao, was known as skilled in military affairs; Rui Lin's subordinates Fang Yao and Zheng Shaozhong could all fight; they successively defeated and slew the Wukeng guest bandits, bandits at Caochong, Chixi, and in Xin'an and Dongguan, and the foreign pirates and bandits of Chaozhou and Qiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The governor at the time, Jiang Yizao, was reputed to know warfare. Rui Lin's subordinates Fang Yao and Zheng Shaozhong were capable fighters, and they successively defeated and killed the Wukeng guest bandits, bandits at Caochong and Chixi and in Xin'an and Dongguan, and the foreign pirates and local bandits of Chaozhou and Qiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，兼署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he concurrently acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he also served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 十年，復拜文淵閣大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was again appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion, still retaining the governorship.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was again appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion while remaining governor-general.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒，詔嘉前勞，贈太保，祀賢良祠，諡文莊。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died; an edict praised his earlier service, posthumously granted him Grand Guardian, enshrined him in the Temple of Worthies, and gave him the posthumous title Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he died. An edict praised his earlier service; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian, enshrined in the Temple of Worthies, and given the posthumous title Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子懷塔布，由廕生授刑部主事，晉員外郎。

translations.literal: His son Huai Tabu, through hereditary privilege as a licentiate, was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice and promoted to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huai Tabu entered office through hereditary privilege as a licentiate, was appointed principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice, and was promoted to vice director.

sentences.zh: 以父卹典擢四品京堂，累遷禮部尚書，充內務府大臣。

translations.literal: Through bereavement honors for his father he was promoted to a fourth-rank capital official, was successively promoted to Minister of Rites, and was appointed minister of the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Through the bereavement honors granted for his father he was promoted to a fourth-rank capital official, rose successively to Minister of Rites, and served as minister of the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十四年，主事王照上書言事，久之始代奏，坐違旨抑格，褫職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, Principal Clerk Wang Zhao submitted a memorial on state affairs; only after a long delay did he transmit it on his behalf; he was found guilty of defying the imperial will by suppressing and delaying it and was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year of Guangxu, Principal Clerk Wang Zhao submitted a memorial on state affairs, but Huai Tabu transmitted it on his behalf only after a long delay. He was found guilty of defying the imperial will by suppressing and delaying the memorial and was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 未幾，皇太后訓政，起授左都御史，复充​​內務府大臣，遷理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Before long, when the Empress Dowager resumed regency, he was recalled and appointed Left Censor-in-Chief, again served as minister of the Imperial Household Department, and was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, when the Empress Dowager resumed regency, he was recalled as Left Censor-in-Chief, again served as minister of the Imperial Household Department, and was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，卒，贈太子少保，諡恪勤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he died; he was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Keqin.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he died. He was posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Keqin.

sentences.zh: 官文，字秀峰，王佳氏，滿洲正白旗人，先隸內務府正白旗漢軍。

translations.literal: Guan Wen, style name Xiufeng, of the Wangjia clan, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, had originally belonged to the Plain White Banner Han Army under the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen, whose style was Xiufeng, belonged to the Wangjia clan. A Manchu of the Plain White Banner, he had originally been attached to the Plain White Banner Han Army under the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 由拜唐阿補藍翎侍衛，累擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Starting as a baitangga assigned as an imperial guardsman with the blue tail feather, he was successively promoted to first-class imperial guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a baitangga assigned to the imperial guard with the blue tail feather, he was successively promoted to first-class imperial guardsman.

sentences.zh: 道光二十一年，出為廣州漢軍副都統，調荊州右翼副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Daoguang he went out as deputy commander of the Guangzhou Han Army and was transferred to deputy commander of the Right Wing at Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Daoguang he served abroad as deputy commander of the Guangzhou Han Army and was transferred to deputy commander of the Right Wing at Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 粵匪既陷漢陽，將犯荊州。

translations.literal: After the Guangdong rebels had taken Hanyang, they were about to threaten Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After the Guangdong rebels had taken Hanyang, they were about to threaten Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，將軍台湧駐防德安，命官文專統荊州防兵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng General Tai Yong garrisoned De'an and ordered Guan Wen to take sole command of the Jingzhou defense troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng General Tai Yong garrisoned De'an and ordered Guan Wen to take sole command of the Jingzhou defense troops.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢荊州將軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to general of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to general of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊陷安陸、荊門、宜昌。

translations.literal: The rebels took Anlu, Jingmen, and Yichang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels took Anlu, Jingmen, and Yichang.

sentences.zh: 時荊州兵多調赴武昌，分屯要隘，城中兵僅二千。

translations.literal: At the time most Jingzhou troops had been transferred to Wuchang and were encamped at strategic passes; only two thousand soldiers remained in the city.
translations.idiomatic: At the time most Jingzhou troops had been transferred to Wuchang and posted at strategic passes, leaving only two thousand soldiers in the city.

sentences.zh: 監利又陷，官文遣軍復之；

translations.literal: Jianli fell again, and Guan Wen sent troops to recover it;
translations.idiomatic: When Jianli fell again, Guan Wen sent troops to recover it;

sentences.zh: 連复宜昌、石首、華容，於是荊州稍安，而武昌被圍急，官文遣將沿漢下援。

translations.literal: He then recovered Yichang, Shishou, and Huarong in succession, so Jingzhou was somewhat secure; but Wuchang was in urgent peril from siege, and Guan Wen sent generals down the Han River in relief.
translations.idiomatic: He then recovered Yichang, Shishou, and Huarong in succession, so Jingzhou was somewhat secure; but Wuchang was under urgent siege, and Guan Wen sent generals down the Han River in relief.

sentences.zh: 六月，武昌复失守，命官文統籌全局，規复武漢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Wuchang again fell; Guan Wen was ordered to coordinate the overall situation and plan the recovery of Wuhan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wuchang again fell. Guan Wen was ordered to coordinate the overall situation and plan the recovery of Wuhan.

sentences.zh: 因疏言：「賊情詭譎，軍情隨時變幻。

translations.literal: He accordingly submitted a memorial saying: "The rebels' dispositions are treacherous and elusive, and military circumstances change from moment to moment.
translations.idiomatic: He accordingly submitted a memorial saying, "The rebels' dispositions are treacherous and elusive, and military circumstances change from moment to moment.

sentences.zh: 武漢之賊一日不盡，荊州不得安枕。

translations.literal: As long as the rebels at Wuhan are not utterly destroyed, Jingzhou cannot rest secure.
translations.idiomatic: As long as the rebels at Wuhan are not utterly destroyed, Jingzhou cannot rest secure.

sentences.zh: 賊踞漢陽，倚江為險，絕我糧道，阻我援軍。

translations.literal: The rebels hold Hanyang, relying on the river as a barrier; they cut our supply lines and block our relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels hold Hanyang, relying on the river as a barrier; they cut our supply lines and block our relief troops.

sentences.zh: 今欲复武昌，必先攻漢陽，奪賊所恃之險，而後武昌可圖也。

translations.literal: If we now wish to recover Wuchang, we must first attack Hanyang and seize the strong points the rebels rely upon; only then can Wuchang be taken.
translations.idiomatic: If we now wish to recover Wuchang, we must first attack Hanyang and seize the strong points the rebels rely upon; only then can Wuchang be taken.

sentences.zh: 總兵雙保自潛江進剿，兵力過單。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Shuangbao is advancing from Qianjiang in suppression, but his force is too thin.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Shuangbao is advancing from Qianjiang in suppression, but his force is too thin.

sentences.zh: 臣已令羅遵殿以戰船百艘自仙桃鎮、蔡店迳趨漢陽，與撫臣楊霈分道夾攻；

translations.literal: I have already ordered Luo Zundian with a hundred war junks to strike directly at Hanyang from Xiantao Town and Caidian, attacking from a separate route in concert with Governor Yang Pai;
translations.idiomatic: I have already ordered Luo Zundian with a hundred war junks to strike directly at Hanyang from Xiantao Town and Caidian, attacking from a separate route in concert with Governor Yang Pai;

sentences.zh: 又檄總兵福炘往助雙保，知縣吳振鏞進复沔陽以通餉道。

translations.literal: I have also ordered Regional Commander Fu Xin to aid Shuangbao, and Magistrate Wu Zhenyong to advance and recover Mianyang to open the supply route.
translations.idiomatic: I have also ordered Regional Commander Fu Xin to aid Shuangbao and Magistrate Wu Zhenyong to advance and recover Mianyang to open the supply route.

sentences.zh: 惟賊踞岳州，南北援軍均受牽制，尤應先剿岳州之賊。

translations.literal: Only the rebels hold Yuezhou, tying down relief forces north and south alike; we should above all first suppress the rebels at Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: But the rebels hold Yuezhou, tying down relief forces north and south alike; we should above all first suppress the rebels at Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 曾國籓方統砲船駐湘陰，塔齊布之師已入岳州境，臣已促其速進，分兵阻江路。

translations.literal: Zeng Guofan is now commanding gunboats stationed at Xiangyin; Ta Qibu's army has already entered Yuezhou territory; I have urged them to advance swiftly and sent troops to block the river route.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Guofan is now commanding gunboats stationed at Xiangyin, and Ta Qibu's army has already entered Yuezhou territory. I have urged them to advance swiftly and sent troops to block the river route.

sentences.zh: 复派同知銜李光榮等率川勇防調弦口，張子銘防監利尺八口，都司宗維清沿江接應。

translations.literal: I have also dispatched Li Guangrong, acting as sub-prefect, and others leading Sichuan braves to guard Diaoxiankou; Zhang Ziming to guard the Chibakou passage at Jianli; and Brigade Commander Zong Weiqing to respond along the river line.
translations.idiomatic: I have also dispatched Li Guangrong, acting as sub-prefect, and others leading Sichuan braves to guard Diaoxiankou; Zhang Ziming to guard the Chibakou passage at Jianli; and Brigade Commander Zong Weiqing to respond along the river line.

sentences.zh: 荊州僅賸旗兵分守要隘，隨時接應，庶幾可進可退，不致有顧此失彼之虞。

translations.literal: At Jingzhou only banner troops remain, posted at strategic passes to respond as needed, so that we may advance or withdraw and not fear losing one place while saving another.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingzhou only banner troops remain, posted at strategic passes to respond as needed, so that we may advance or withdraw without fear of losing one place while saving another.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted and acknowledged.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted and acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 尋曾國籓克岳州，賊艘悉出大江，官文遣涼州副都統魁玉、總兵楊昌泗赴螺山防江，殲賊甚多。

translations.literal: Before long Zeng Guofan took Yuezhou; the rebel vessels all poured into the great river; Guan Wen sent Deputy Commander of Liangzhou Kui Yu and Regional Commander Yang Changsi to Luoshan to guard the river and destroyed many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zeng Guofan took Yuezhou, and the rebel vessels all poured into the great river. Guan Wen sent Deputy Commander of Liangzhou Kui Yu and Regional Commander Yang Changsi to Luoshan to guard the river and destroyed many rebels.

sentences.zh: 八月，武昌、漢陽相繼复，論功被優敘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Wuchang and Hanyang were recovered in succession; for merit he received special commendation in the roster of rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Wuchang and Hanyang were recovered in succession, and for merit he received special commendation in the roster of rewards.

sentences.zh: 五年，總督楊霈師潰德安，漢陽、漢口復陷，德安、隨州繼之，詔褫霈職，授官文湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Governor-General Yang Pai's army was routed at De'an; Hanyang and Hankou again fell, followed by De'an and Suizhou; an edict stripped Yang Pai of office and appointed Guan Wen governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Governor-General Yang Pai's army was routed at De'an. Hanyang and Hankou again fell, followed by De'an and Suizhou. An edict stripped Yang Pai of office and appointed Guan Wen governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 師次安陸，疏言：「賊自隨州退踞德安，兇鋒疊挫。

translations.literal: The army halted at Anlu, and he submitted a memorial saying: "The rebels retreated from Suizhou and hold De'an; their fierce momentum has been repeatedly blunted.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Anlu, and he submitted a memorial saying, "The rebels retreated from Suizhou and hold De'an; their fierce momentum has been repeatedly blunted.

sentences.zh: 惟天門、京山道路四通，儻竄襄河，勾連仙桃鎮以下股匪，不獨荊襄在在堪虞，上游各處均可北竄。

translations.literal: Only Tianmen and Jingshan are crossroads in every direction; if they slip into the Xiang River region and link up with rebel bands below Xiantao Town, not only will Jing and Xiang be everywhere imperiled — every place upstream may flee northward.
translations.idiomatic: But Tianmen and Jingshan are crossroads in every direction; if the rebels slip into the Xiang River region and link up with rebel bands below Xiantao Town, not only will Jing and Xiang be everywhere imperiled — every place upstream may flee northward.

sentences.zh: 現遣兵一由天門、皁市進剿，一往京山防守，臣駐安陸為兩路應援，諮固原提督孔廣順伺隙進取，署提臣訥欽為後應。

translations.literal: I am now sending troops: one column advancing from Tianmen and Zaoshi in suppression, another to hold Jingshan in defense; I am stationed at Anlu to support both routes; I have instructed Regional Commander Kong Guangshun of Guyuan to seize an opening and advance, with Acting Governor Neyin as rear support.
translations.idiomatic: I am now sending troops: one column advancing from Tianmen and Zaoshi in suppression, another to hold Jingshan in defense. I am stationed at Anlu to support both routes, have instructed Regional Commander Kong Guangshun of Guyuan to seize an opening and advance, and have Acting Governor Neyin as rear support.

sentences.zh: 俟欽差大臣西凌阿入楚，即統兵從襄河兩岸水陸並進，由漢川攻漢陽。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Commissioner Xiling'a enters Hubei, he will at once lead troops by land and water along both banks of the Xiang River, attacking Hanyang by way of Hanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Imperial Commissioner Xiling'a enters Hubei, he will at once lead troops by land and water along both banks of the Xiang River, attacking Hanyang by way of Hanchuan.

sentences.zh: 」秋，西凌阿戰德安失利，乃命官文代為欽差大臣，馳援德安。

translations.literal: " In autumn Xiling'a was defeated at De'an; Guan Wen was then appointed Imperial Commissioner in his stead and rushed to relieve De'an.
translations.idiomatic: " In autumn Xiling'a was defeated at De'an. Guan Wen was then appointed Imperial Commissioner in his stead and rushed to relieve De'an.

sentences.zh: 賊棄城走，躡追之，直搗漢陽。

translations.literal: The rebels abandoned the city and fled; he pursued them and drove straight at Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels abandoned the city and fled; he pursued them and drove straight at Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，督兵薄西門橋，迭敗賊於龜山、尾湖堤、五顯廟，破賊卡，毀東西土城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he led troops close to Ximen Bridge, repeatedly defeating the rebels at Guishan, Weihudi, and Wuxian Temple, breaking their stockades and destroying the eastern and western earthen walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he led troops close to Ximen Bridge, repeatedly defeating the rebels at Guishan, Weihudi, and Wuxian Temple, breaking their stockades and destroying the eastern and western earthen walls.

sentences.zh: 六年，賊造浮橋從西門分隊來犯，擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the rebels built a pontoon bridge and came in separate columns from the west gate to attack; he drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the rebels built a pontoon bridge and came in separate columns from the west gate to attack; he drove them back.

sentences.zh: 分兵河口斷其糧道，令副都統都興阿攻圍風焚積聚，賊勢漸蹙。

translations.literal: He divided troops at the river mouth to cut their supply lines and ordered Deputy Commander Duxing'a to attack Weifeng and burn their stores; the rebel force gradually narrowed.
translations.idiomatic: He divided troops at the river mouth to cut their supply lines and ordered Deputy Commander Duxing'a to attack Weifeng and burn their stores, and the rebel force gradually narrowed.

sentences.zh: 秋，破漢陽城外賊營，連戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In autumn he broke the rebel camps outside Hanyang; battle after battle was won.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn he broke the rebel camps outside Hanyang, winning battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 巡撫胡林翼規复武昌。

translations.literal: Governor Hu Linyi planned the recovery of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Hu Linyi planned the recovery of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 十一月，約同日水陸大舉，分攻武、漢，官文督軍分路進，水師擊漢陽東門，破五顯廟賊卡，李孟群又敗龜山援賊，王國才、楊昌泗由西門攻入，遂復漢陽，俘偽將軍等五百餘人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month they agreed on a same-day joint land-and-water offensive, attacking Wu and Han separately; Guan Wen directed the army in columns; the navy struck Hanyang's east gate and broke the Wuxian Temple stockade; Li Mengqun again defeated the Guishan relief rebels; Wang Guocai and Yang Changsi entered through the west gate, and Hanyang was recovered, with more than five hundred false generals and others captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month they agreed on a same-day joint land-and-water offensive, attacking Wu and Han separately. Guan Wen directed the army in columns; the navy struck Hanyang's east gate and broke the Wuxian Temple stockade; Li Mengqun again defeated the Guishan relief rebels; Wang Guocai and Yang Changsi entered through the west gate. Hanyang was recovered, and more than five hundred false generals and others were captured.

sentences.zh: 林翼亦復武昌，詔嘉獎，賜花翎。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi also recovered Wuchang; an edict praised and rewarded them; they were granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi also recovered Wuchang. An edict praised and rewarded them, and they were granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 七年，偕林翼疏言：「湖北為長江上游要害，武漢尤九省通衢，自來東南有事必爭之地。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he and Hu Linyi jointly submitted a memorial saying: "Hubei is the strategic key to the upper Yangtze; Wuhan above all is the thoroughfare linking nine provinces — whenever trouble arises in the southeast it is always contested ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he and Hu Linyi jointly submitted a memorial saying, "Hubei is the strategic key to the upper Yangtze; Wuhan above all is the thoroughfare linking nine provinces — whenever trouble arises in the southeast it is always contested ground.

sentences.zh: 三次失陷，力攻兩載而後克之。

translations.literal: It fell three times and was taken only after two years of hard fighting.
translations.idiomatic: It fell three times and was taken only after two years of hard fighting.

sentences.zh: 目前相機防剿，不令賊乘間上竄，蹈從前覆轍。

translations.literal: At present we are adapting defense and suppression to circumstances, not allowing the rebels to seize an opening and flee upstream and repeat the disasters of the past.
translations.idiomatic: At present we are adapting defense and suppression to circumstances, not allowing the rebels to seize an opening and flee upstream and repeat the disasters of the past.

sentences.zh: 業派李續賓由南岸，都興阿、孔廣順、王國才由北岸，楊載福率水師由江路分道進剿。

translations.literal: We have already dispatched Li Xubin along the south bank; Duxing'a, Kong Guangshun, and Wang Guocai along the north bank; and Yang Zaifu leading the navy along the river route in separate columns of suppression.
translations.idiomatic: We have already dispatched Li Xubin along the south bank; Duxing'a, Kong Guangshun, and Wang Guocai along the north bank; and Yang Zaifu leading the navy along the river route in separate columns of suppression.

sentences.zh: 現北岸黃州至黃梅，南岸武昌至興國，均已肅清，崇、通一帶搜捕殆盡；

translations.literal: The north bank from Huangzhou to Huangmei and the south bank from Wuchang to Xingguo have now been thoroughly cleared; in the Chongyang-Tongcheng region pursuit and search have nearly exhausted the rebels;
translations.idiomatic: The north bank from Huangzhou to Huangmei and the south bank from Wuchang to Xingguo have now been thoroughly cleared, and in the Chongyang-Tongcheng region pursuit and search have nearly exhausted the rebels;

sentences.zh: 李續賓抵九江，與曾國籓會合進攻；

translations.literal: Li Xubin has reached Jiujiang and joined Zeng Guofan in a joint advance;
translations.idiomatic: Li Xubin has reached Jiujiang and joined Zeng Guofan in a joint advance;

sentences.zh: 楊載福毀城外賊營；

translations.literal: Yang Zaifu has destroyed the rebel camps outside the walls;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaifu has destroyed the rebel camps outside the walls;

sentences.zh: 惟小池口賊壘未拔，派鮑超助攻。

translations.literal: Only the rebel fortress at Xiaochikou has not yet been taken; Bao Chao has been dispatched to assist in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: Only the rebel fortress at Xiaochikou has not yet been taken; Bao Chao has been dispatched to assist in the attack.

sentences.zh: 安徽之英山、太湖、宿松、望江接壤湖北，皆為賊藪，有窺伺上犯之心。

translations.literal: Yingshan, Taihu, Susong, and Wangjiang in Anhui border Hubei and are all rebel haunts; they watch for a chance to strike upward.
translations.idiomatic: Yingshan, Taihu, Susong, and Wangjiang in Anhui border Hubei and are all rebel haunts; they watch for a chance to strike upward.

sentences.zh: 飭王國才駐黃梅之大河鋪、界嶺岩，孔廣順駐蘄水之孔隴驛，巴揚阿率馬隊為各路應援，以固楚北門戶。

translations.literal: I have ordered Wang Guocai to garrison Dahepu and Jielingyan in Huangmei, Kong Guangshun to garrison Konglong Post in Qishui, and Bayang'a to lead cavalry in support for all routes, to secure the northern gateway of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: I have ordered Wang Guocai to garrison Dahepu and Jielingyan in Huangmei, Kong Guangshun to garrison Konglong Post in Qishui, and Bayang'a to lead cavalry in support for all routes, to secure the northern gateway of Chu.

sentences.zh: 道士洑水闊溜急，田家鎮兩山對峙，水師皆難久駐，酌留各營遊巡江面，足備鎮馭。

translations.literal: The Daoshifu channel is wide and the current swift; at Tianjiazhen two mountains stand facing each other; the navy cannot long remain there; I have judged it best to leave various battalions patrolling the river surface, sufficient to control and restrain.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoshifu channel is wide and the current swift; at Tianjiazhen two mountains stand facing each other. The navy cannot long remain there, so I have judged it best to leave various battalions patrolling the river surface, sufficient to control and restrain.

sentences.zh: 通籌大局，我軍已據水陸上游，實蓄破竹建瓴之勢。

translations.literal: Viewing the overall situation, our army already holds the upper reaches by land and water — we truly possess momentum like splitting bamboo or water pouring from a height.
translations.idiomatic: Viewing the overall situation, our army already holds the upper reaches by land and water — we truly possess momentum like splitting bamboo or water pouring from a height.

sentences.zh: 所慮江西七府未平，武昌尚有肘腋之患。

translations.literal: What we fear is that the seven prefectures of Jiangxi are not yet pacified and Wuchang still has trouble at its side.
translations.idiomatic: What we fear is that the seven prefectures of Jiangxi are not yet pacified and Wuchang still has trouble at its side.

sentences.zh: 賊若由通城、崇陽、興國竄逼武昌，反出江西各軍之上，自當固守武昌，以為後路根本。

translations.literal: If the rebels slip through Tongcheng, Chongyang, and Xingguo and press upon Wuchang, rising above the Jiangxi armies, we should of course hold Wuchang fast as the foundation of our rear.
translations.idiomatic: If the rebels slip through Tongcheng, Chongyang, and Xingguo and press upon Wuchang, rising above the Jiangxi armies, we should of course hold Wuchang fast as the foundation of our rear.

sentences.zh: 相機籌畫，節節進取，仍步步嚴防，庶軍情無返顧掣肘之虞，轉餉有源源不竭之利。

translations.literal: Adapting plans to circumstances, advancing step by step while guarding every step strictly, we may then keep military affairs from looking back in fear of being hampered and keep the transport of supplies flowing without end.
translations.idiomatic: Adapting plans to circumstances, advancing step by step while guarding every step strictly, we may then keep military affairs from looking back in fear of being hampered and keep the transport of supplies flowing without end.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted and acknowledged.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted and acknowledged.

sentences.zh: 初，官文由荊州將軍調總督，凡上游荊、市、襄、鄖諸郡兵事餉事悉主之。

translations.literal: At first, when Guan Wen was transferred from general of Jingzhou to governor-general, he had charge of all military and supply affairs in the upstream prefectures of Jing, Shi, Xiang, and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Guan Wen was transferred from general of Jingzhou to governor-general, he had charge of all military and supply affairs in the upstream prefectures of Jing, Shi, Xiang, and Yun.

sentences.zh: 林翼以巡撫駐金口，凡下游武、漢、黃、德諸郡兵事餉事悉主之。

translations.literal: Hu Linyi as governor was stationed at Jinkou and had charge of all military and supply affairs in the downstream prefectures of Wu, Han, Huang, and De.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Linyi as governor was stationed at Jinkou and had charge of all military and supply affairs in the downstream prefectures of Wu, Han, Huang, and De.

sentences.zh: 南北軍各領分地，徵兵調餉，每有違言。

translations.literal: The northern and southern armies each held their own sectors; when levying troops and shifting supplies there were often disputes.
translations.idiomatic: The northern and southern armies each held their own sectors, and when levying troops and shifting supplies there were often disputes.

sentences.zh: 武昌既复，林翼威望日起，官文自知不及，思假以為重，林翼益推誠相結納，於是吏治、財政、軍事悉聽林翼主持，官文畫諾而已。

translations.literal: Once Wuchang was recovered, Hu Linyi's prestige rose day by day; Guan Wen knew himself unequal and wished to borrow that weight; Hu Linyi in turn opened himself in good faith and drew closer; thereafter civil administration, finance, and military affairs were all left to Hu Linyi to direct, and Guan Wen merely assented.
translations.idiomatic: Once Wuchang was recovered, Hu Linyi's prestige rose day by day. Guan Wen knew himself unequal and wished to borrow that weight; Hu Linyi in turn opened himself in good faith and drew closer. Thereafter civil administration, finance, and military affairs were all left to Hu Linyi to direct, and Guan Wen merely assented.

sentences.zh: 不數年，足食足兵，東南大局，隱然以湖北為之樞。

translations.literal: Within a few years there was ample food and ample troops; the great strategic situation in the southeast quietly turned on Hubei as its pivot.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years there was ample food and ample troops, and the great strategic situation in the southeast quietly turned on Hubei as its pivot.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，复九江，論功，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year Jiujiang was recovered; for merit he was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year Jiujiang was recovered, and for merit he was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 皖賊陷麻城、黃安，圍蘄州，先後破走之。

translations.literal: Anhui rebels took Macheng and Huang'an and besieged Qizhou; he successively defeated and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui rebels took Macheng and Huang'an and besieged Qizhou; he successively defeated and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 七月，胡林翼丁母憂，官文疏請留林翼治軍，改為署理，從之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Hu Linyi entered mourning for his mother; Guan Wen memorialized requesting that Hu Linyi remain to direct the army, his post changed to acting appointment; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Hu Linyi entered mourning for his mother. Guan Wen memorialized requesting that Hu Linyi remain to direct the army, with his post changed to an acting appointment; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 命官文暫行兼署巡撫，尋以湖廣總督協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Guan Wen was ordered temporarily to act also as governor; soon he was made Grand Secretary with concurrent charge as governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen was ordered temporarily to act also as governor, and soon he was made Grand Secretary with concurrent charge as governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 李續賓戰歿三河，皖、鄂震動。

translations.literal: Li Xubin was killed in battle at Sanhe; Anhui and Hubei were shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xubin was killed in battle at Sanhe, and Anhui and Hubei were shaken.

sentences.zh: 官文分兵扼蘄州、廣濟、麻城諸隘，固守九江、彭澤，水師嚴防江面，人心始定。

translations.literal: Guan Wen divided troops to hold the passes at Qizhou, Guangji, and Macheng, held fast at Jiujiang and Pengze, and had the navy strictly guard the river surface; morale then steadied.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen divided troops to hold the passes at Qizhou, Guangji, and Macheng, held fast at Jiujiang and Pengze, and had the navy strictly guard the river surface, and morale then steadied.

sentences.zh: 九年，賊竄湖南，圍寶慶，檄荊宜施道李續宜赴援，大破之，寶慶圍解。

translations.literal: In the ninth year rebels fled into Hunan and besieged Baoqing; he ordered Jing-Yi-Shi Circuit Intendant Li Xuyi to go in relief; the rebels were heavily defeated and the siege of Baoqing was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year rebels fled into Hunan and besieged Baoqing. He ordered Jing-Yi-Shi Circuit Intendant Li Xuyi to go in relief; the rebels were heavily defeated and the siege of Baoqing was lifted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，复太湖，被優敘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Taihu was recovered; he received special commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Taihu was recovered, and he received special commendation.

sentences.zh: 十一年，拜文淵閣大學士，仍留總督任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion while remaining governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion while remaining governor-general.

sentences.zh: 時大軍圍安慶急，陳玉成、李秀成先後分兵犯湖北境，冀掣動局勢，遣將迭破之，所陷諸郡縣皆复。

translations.literal: At the time the main army was pressing the siege of Anqing; Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng successively sent columns to raid the Hubei border, hoping to loosen the situation; he dispatched generals who repeatedly defeated them, and every county and prefecture that had fallen was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the main army was pressing the siege of Anqing. Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng successively sent columns to raid the Hubei border, hoping to loosen the situation. He dispatched generals who repeatedly defeated them, and every county and prefecture that had fallen was recovered.

sentences.zh: 八月，克安慶，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Anqing was taken; he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Anqing was taken, and he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 是年，胡林翼病歿，嚴樹森代之。

translations.literal: That year Hu Linyi died of illness; Yan Shusen replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Hu Linyi died of illness, and Yan Shusen replaced him.

sentences.zh: 降捻苗沛霖踞安徽壽州，詔疆臣議剿撫之策。

translations.literal: The surrendered Nian bandit Miao Peilin held Shouzhou in Anhui; an edict ordered frontier officials to discuss strategies of suppression and pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered Nian bandit Miao Peilin held Shouzhou in Anhui, and an edict ordered frontier officials to discuss strategies of suppression and pacification.

sentences.zh: 官文疏陳沛霖包藏禍心，罪大惡極，請伸天討。

translations.literal: Guan Wen memorialized that Peilin harbored treacherous intent, his crimes were extreme, and he requested heaven's punishment be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Wen memorialized that Peilin harbored treacherous intent, his crimes were extreme, and he requested that heaven's punishment be carried out.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，遣副將周鳳山等剿捻於河南信陽、羅山，敗之；

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he dispatched Vice General Zhou Fengshan and others to suppress Nian bandits at Xinyang and Luoshan in Henan and defeated them;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi he dispatched Vice General Zhou Fengshan and others to suppress Nian bandits at Xinyang and Luoshan in Henan and defeated them;

sentences.zh: 又破黃梅捻巢，收復十餘寨：晉文華殿大學士。

translations.literal: He also broke Nian lairs at Huangmei and recovered more than ten stockades: he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He also broke Nian lairs at Huangmei and recovered more than ten stockades, and was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 發、捻合擾楚、豫之交，勢甚熾。

translations.literal: Taiping and Nian forces jointly harassed the border of Hubei and Henan; their momentum was very fierce.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping and Nian forces jointly harassed the border of Hubei and Henan, and their momentum was very fierce.

sentences.zh: 荊州將軍多隆阿方督師赴陝西，官文以楚兵不敷分佈，奏調回援。

translations.literal: General of Jingzhou Duolong'a was then commanding troops bound for Shaanxi; Guan Wen, finding Huguang troops insufficient for deployment, memorialized to recall him for relief.
translations.idiomatic: General of Jingzhou Duolong'a was then commanding troops bound for Shaanxi. Guan Wen, finding Huguang troops insufficient for deployment, memorialized to recall him for relief.

sentences.zh: 九月，多隆阿至，屢戰皆捷，襄河以北賊皆遠遁。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Duolong'a arrived; battle after battle was won, and north of the Xiang River the rebels all fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Duolong'a arrived. Battle after battle was won, and north of the Xiang River the rebels all fled far away.

sentences.zh: 三年，劾巡撫嚴樹森把持剛愎，黜之。

translations.literal: In the third year he impeached Governor Yan Shusen for domineering obstinacy and had him removed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he impeached Governor Yan Shusen for domineering obstinacy and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 六月，克復江寧，曾國籓奏捷，推官文列名疏首。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Jiangning was recovered; Zeng Guofan reported victory and placed Guan Wen's name first on the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Jiangning was recovered. Zeng Guofan reported victory and placed Guan Wen's name first on the memorial.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉官文徵兵籌餉，推賢讓能，接濟東征，不分畛域，錫封一等伯爵，號果威，世襲罔替，升入正白旗滿洲，賜雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: An edict praised Guan Wen for raising troops and gathering supplies, recommending the worthy and yielding to the able, aiding the eastern campaign without regard to boundaries; he was enfeoffed as a first-class earl with the style Guowei, inheritable in perpetuity; he was transferred into the Manchu Plain White Banner and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Guan Wen for raising troops and gathering supplies, recommending the worthy and yielding to the able, and aiding the eastern campaign without regard to boundaries. He was enfeoffed as a first-class earl with the style Guowei, inheritable in perpetuity; he was transferred into the Manchu Plain White Banner and granted the double-eyed peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 蓋褒其能與胡林翼和衷卒成大功也。

translations.literal: This was to commend his ability to work in harmony with Hu Linyi and bring the great achievement to completion.
translations.idiomatic: This was to commend his ability to work in harmony with Hu Linyi and bring the great achievement to completion.

sentences.zh: 四年，僧格林沁剿捻戰歿於山東，詔追論前年發、捻擾湖北，官文不能就地殲除，僅驅出境，以致蔓延益熾，下嚴議，降三級調用，改革職留任，褫宮銜、花翎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Sengge Rinchen was killed suppressing Nian bandits in Shandong; an edict retrospectively reviewed how Taiping and Nian forces had harassed Hubei the year before: Guan Wen had not been able to destroy them on the spot but had only driven them beyond the border, so that they spread and grew fiercer; a severe inquiry was ordered; he was demoted three ranks and transferred, changing his original post while retaining office, and was stripped of his palace rank and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Sengge Rinchen was killed suppressing Nian bandits in Shandong. An edict retrospectively reviewed how Taiping and Nian forces had harassed Hubei the year before: Guan Wen had not been able to destroy them on the spot but had only driven them beyond the border, so that they spread and grew fiercer. A severe inquiry was ordered; he was demoted three ranks and transferred, changing his original post while retaining office, and was stripped of his palace rank and peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 五年，偕曾國籓奏設長江水師，如議行。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he and Zeng Guofan jointly memorialized to establish a Yangtze River navy; the proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he and Zeng Guofan jointly memorialized to establish a Yangtze River navy, and the proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 湖北巡撫曾國荃劾官文貪庸驕蹇，命尚書綿森、侍郎譚廷襄往按，坐動用捐款，議革職，詔念前勞，原其尚非貪污欺罔，優與保全，解總督，仍留大學士、伯爵，罰伯俸十年。

translations.literal: Hubei Governor Zeng Guoquan impeached Guan Wen for greed, mediocrity, arrogance, and obstinacy; Ministers Mian Sen and Vice Minister Tan Tingxiang were sent to investigate; he was found guilty of misusing contributed funds; dismissal was proposed; an edict, recalling his earlier service and finding that he was not guilty of embezzlement or fraud, showed lenient preservation: he was relieved of the governorship but retained as grand secretary and earl, with his earldom stipend withheld for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Hubei Governor Zeng Guoquan impeached Guan Wen for greed, mediocrity, arrogance, and obstinacy. Ministers Mian Sen and Vice Minister Tan Tingxiang were sent to investigate. He was found guilty of misusing contributed funds, and dismissal was proposed. An edict, recalling his earlier service and finding that he was not guilty of embezzlement or fraud, showed lenient preservation: he was relieved of the governorship but retained as grand secretary and earl, with his earldom stipend withheld for ten years.

sentences.zh: 召還京，管理刑部，兼正白旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He was recalled to the capital to administer the Ministry of Justice and concurrently serve as commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to the capital to administer the Ministry of Justice and concurrently serve as commander of the Mongol Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 尋出署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Soon he went out to act as governor-general of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he went out to act as governor-general of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 七年，捻匪張總愚由西路竄擾畿輔，下嚴議。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Nian rebel Zhang Zongyu raided the capital region from the west; a severe inquiry was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Nian rebel Zhang Zongyu raided the capital region from the west, and a severe inquiry was ordered.

sentences.zh: 尋李鴻章、左宗棠等入援，七月，捻匪平，复宮銜、花翎。

translations.literal: Before long Li Hongzhang, Zuo Zongtang, and others entered in relief; in the seventh month the Nian rebels were pacified, and his palace rank and peacock feather were restored.
